thread:
mike: Observed intermittent failures in the sampleapp embedding -> rerank integration. Repro below; looks like vector dim mismatch and occasionally 400s from rerank.

nina: can you paste the repro steps?

mike: repro: 1) post 200 small docs quickly to /ingest which uses embed.batchByTokenWindow 2) wait for returned vectors 3) call /rerank with those vectors. Sometimes rerank responds with fewer scores than candidates or server 400.

mike: minimal example curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{\"model\":\"open-embed-lite\",\"input\":[\"a\",\"b\",\"c\"]}'
```

mike: expected: 3 vectors of dim 96 each. actual: sometimes second vector is 95 floats. other times rerank returns scores length 2 for 3 candidates.

li: I saw similar a while back. The batching helper compacts by token window and streams; if an auth refresh triggers a retry while the batch buffer is being built, it can resend a truncated body.

rob: logs show correlated 401->refresh->retry events at about the same timestamp as the bad batches. Also noticed batch_sent metric byte_size not matching actual payload size.

nina: can we reproduce deterministically?

mike: yes. quick node script toggling token TTL down to 3s + burst ingest triggers it in ~5 runs.

qa-bot: reproduction script snippet:
```js
for (let i=0;i<10;i++) { await ingestMany(250, {batchWindowMs: 8, tokenTtlSec: 3}); }
```

li: immediate mitigation: add a pre-send sanity check that asserts every vector length == declared dim and rejects the batch if not. That prevents corrupt payloads from reaching rerank. We can optionally pad.

rob: long term: protect the batch builder from concurrent mutation. Options: serialize access to buffer, or make a defensive immutable copy before invoking network send. Also add a local checksum on the payload (e.g., sha1) and log it on send/receive to catch mismatches.

nina: agree. we also need to make rerank strict: if scores.length !== candidates.length -> return 502 with clear error and log an incident id. Currently downstream apps get NPEs because we return partial arrays.

mike: I'll draft a patch: (A) make batchByTokenWindow do copy-on-send (B) add optional per-batch checksum logging flag (C) add server-side rerank validation error code + helpful message + unit test in sampleapp.

li: don't forget SDK parity: replicate pad/trim utility across node/go/python SDKs so onboarding examples behave the same. Users keep porting sample code between languages.

rob: QA checklist: 1) run burst ingest with token ttl=3s for 30 mins 2) check no dim < declared_dim 3) ensure rerank returns scores length == candidates length or returns 502 4) gather checksum logs to validate no resend truncation.

mike: small helper to include in docs for immediate user use:
```py
def ensure_dim(vec, dim):
  if len(vec) == dim: return vec
  if len(vec) < dim: return vec + [0.0]*(dim-len(vec))
  return vec[:dim]
```

nina: add a short note to the onboarding README under "Embedding/Rerank sanity checks" with this snippet and explanation. New users often miss this and it leads to confusing failures.

mike: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/sampleapp/pulls/5899 (WIP) — includes tests and docs change. Tagging @docs @eng-runtime for review.

docs-bot: CI: sampleapp integration flakiness increased by 4 failures in last 24h (link: https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/sampleapp)

rob: thanks team. after PR merges, let's land a short-lived feature flag to enable checksum logs in staging for 24h and then disable. Post results in this thread.

mike: will run overnight and report back. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
